profiles.name: single-user-vision
profiles.description: One image request at a time with the Qwen3.5 vision tower and plain decode; DFlash speculation is disabled.

profiles.name: p300x2
profiles.description: Interactive default on two p300 boards (4 dies): 32 sequences, 262144 context, text + images, MTP speculative decoding at one user (about 50 tok/s), thinking on. First token 0.32 s at 1 user, 6.3 s for a 32-request burst.

profiles.name: p300x2-burst
profiles.description: Many short prompts arriving together (chat front-ends, batch jobs): batched short-prompt prefill ON - first token for a 32-request burst 3.8 s instead of 6.3 s (8 users 1.27 s instead of 1.83 s), decode unchanged. Trade-off: a request's first token depends slightly on what arrived with it (seeded reproducibility and greedy consistency across batch compositions are not guaranteed; 12 / 73 conformance tests fail in that mode).

profiles.name: p300x2-longctx
profiles.description: Long prompts mixed with short ones: chunked prefill ON (2048-token scheduler chunks, prefill steps shared between prompts so a short prompt no longer waits for a 100K one to finish) with MTP off (the plugin cannot chunk a multi-token-per-step model). Single-user decode about 30 tok/s instead of 50; running users still pause during prefill steps (the plugin never mixes prefill and decode in one step).

profiles.name: p300x2-text
profiles.description: Text only, largest KV pool: the vision tower is not loaded (28472 KV blocks of 64 tokens instead of 22725, i.e. 1.8 M pooled tokens for the 32 slots) and image requests are rejected at the front end. Otherwise the default.

profiles.name: p150x4
profiles.description: Four p150 boards, the interactive default (thinking on, MTP at one user, text + images).

profiles.name: p150x4-burst
profiles.description: Four p150 boards, batched short-prompt prefill ON (many short prompts arriving together); see p300x2-burst.

profiles.name: p150x4-longctx
profiles.description: Four p150 boards, chunked prefill ON with MTP off (long prompts mixed with short ones); see p300x2-longctx.

profiles.name: p150x4-text
profiles.description: Four p150 boards, text only with the largest KV pool (no vision tower); see p300x2-text.

profiles.name: c32k
profiles.description: One interactive user, 32k context (32704 tokens), MTP drafting (--mtp 4) for greedy and sampled requests, 2048-row prefill slabs ahead of 128-row chunks (--prefill-slab 2048), the fused GDN verify-rows program, the MoE rows on two rings and the rsqrt-last gated-residual front by default; image_url parts (data URLs) served by the resident vision tower, a follow-up turn on an image prefills only the new turn. The configuration the numbers were measured at.

profiles.name: c64k
profiles.description: One interactive user, 64k context (65472 tokens). About 10 GB more component cache on first use.

profiles.name: c128k
profiles.description: One interactive user, 128k context (131008 tokens).

profiles.name: c32k-lanes4
profiles.description: Opt-in: up to four greedy requests decode at once through the MTP lane chain (--lanes 4 --mtp 4; four more wait in the queue), 32k context, 128-row chunked prefill (no slab), the same fused set as c32k; image_url parts (data URLs) served as on the single stream since 2026-09-29 (the tower runs inside the lane admission; a lane's image stream is the single stream's byte for byte). Greedy only (a sampling field gets HTTP 400). Per request slower than c32k, in aggregate faster; an admission runs in segments with the decoding lanes' passes between them (--lanes-stall-budget 0.5 s default).

profiles.name: c32k-quietbox
profiles.description: 32k context on a TT-QuietBox (4x p150 in an ethernet ring), the server's tt-quietbox profile (its 1x4 line descriptor, 4 ethernet channels per link). NOT for a TT-QuietBox 2 (2x p300c): use c32k-quietbox2.

profiles.name: c32k-quietbox2
profiles.description: 32k context on a TT-QuietBox 2 (2x p300c = 4 Blackhole dies in one ethernet ring), the server's tt-quietbox-2 profile (its 1x4 line descriptor, 2 channels per link). Since 2026-09-29 the decode linears read each DRAM bank with two cores on its differently harvested dies too (the first die's placement shared by every die; READY carries dram_workers_per_bank and dram_workers_placement), the 4x p150 line's rows.

profiles.name: p150-eval
profiles.description: Validated accuracy recipe: 64k context, single user, thinking on, async off, bounded sliding + 4k chunked prefill. 71.7% GPQA Diamond (99/198).

profiles.name: p150-smoke
profiles.description: Short-context (4k) single-user smoke / determinism check. Not accuracy validated -- for fast bring-up only.

profiles.name: p150
profiles.description: Single P150; 131,072-token context. The KV pool is sized from the DRAM left after the weights load (1,509 blocks; one 131k request or about 16 concurrent 1k-context sequences), with an admission reserve so residents are not preempted.

profiles.name: p150x2
profiles.description: Two chips, (1, 2) mesh, FABRIC_2D; 262,144-token context. Validated on a TT-QuietBox 2 (2x P300C, 4 chips), where the launch opens a 2x2 parent mesh and serves on the (1, 2) submesh at offset (0, 0).

profiles.name: p150x4
profiles.description: Four P150 boards, (1, 4) mesh, FABRIC_1D_RING; 262,144-token context.

profiles.name: default
profiles.description: Interactive and agentic traffic: chat, multi-turn, agents, RAG, mixed prompt lengths. Long prompts are prefilled in 8,192-token steps with 8 decode steps for the running users between the steps of one prompt, so every user keeps receiving tokens; prefix caching on.

profiles.name: throughput
profiles.description: Bulk work where only the time to finish a batch counts (evals at 32 concurrent requests, offline summarization or classification, batch document processing): prefill-first scheduling in 32,768-token steps, no decode steps between the steps of one prompt; prefix caching on. Lower time to finish a burst of long prompts, no streaming during another user's long prefill.
